_to_exact_decimal(value) formats floats via Decimal(f'{value:.12f}'), which rounds 0.0100000000001 and 0.0100000000002 to Decimal('0.010000000000'), turning strictly unequal costs into a false tie and allowing C2 to win on latency.

median_latency_ms is converted via _to_exact_decimal(value) = Decimal(f'{value:.12f}'), which rounds distinct IEEE-754 floats (e.g. C1=1.0000000000002 ms vs C2=1.0000000000001 ms) both to Decimal('1.000000000000'), collapsing strictly unequal latencies into a false tie and selecting C1 via FINAL_ADMINISTRATIVE_TIEBREAK_C1_GT_C2_GT_C3 instead of C2 at MEDIAN_LATENCY.
